strings.뭐야, 이거? 네가 어떻게 이걸 찾은 거야?: What's this? How did you find it?
strings.이오 말대로 마들린에게 이야기를 듣고, 메아리의 샘에 갔더니 이런 게 있: I talked to Madeleine like you suggested, then went to the Echo Spring and found it there.
I gave one to Madeleine, then went back for another to bring to you.
It's been so long since I last saw one in person... Not since I was a child...
It's a gift. Madeleine wanted you to have it. So did I.
strings.(이오가 살며시 미소를 짓자 이오의 손에 있던 얼음이 녹는다.): (Io smiles softly, and the ice in her hand melts.)
strings.데보라 눈꽃인데, 정확히는 영원의 눈꽃이라고 해. 얼음 속에 갇힌 꽃,: It's a Deborah Snowflower. More precisely, an Eternal Snowflake. A flower encased in ice, eternal hope and endless comfort...
It must have been near where Echo was.
...I gave it to her when she was feeling anxious.
Anyway, thank you. Let's make sure we protect this hope and comfort.
strings.네, 꼭 그렇게 해요. 우리! 그런데 좀 쉬신다고 하지 않았어요?: Yes, let's. Together! But didn't you say you were going to rest?
I did. I wanted a few days without a thought in my head, but that doesn't seem likely.
Nothing's wrong... I just want something delicious to eat.
Not that Galette's cooking isn't delicious. I just want something different...
strings.가끔 케이크 같은 걸 놓고 도망가는 녀석들이 있긴 한데, 요즘은 그것도: Some people used to leave cakes and things and run away, but I haven't seen much of them lately...
You know them too, right? The ones in black.
They do give me piles of food every time I visit.
strings.거기 음식 만드는 법을 갈렛에게 알려주고 싶은데, 부탁해도 될까?: I'd like Galette to learn how to make their food. Could I ask you to help?
Of course. It's a favor for you, after all.
strings.후후, 고마워. 그러면 뭔가 알게 되면 바로 갈렛에게 가봐. 나에게 올: Hehe. Thank you. If you find anything out, go straight to Galette. No need to come back to me.
I will. See you later, Io.
strings.모험가님, 안녕하세요. 고구마 무스 케이크와 티라미슈, 치즈 케이크, 어: Hello, Adventurer. Would you like sweet potato mousse cake, tiramisu, or cheesecake? We have carrot cake too.
W-wait a moment. You're offering me all this already...?
strings.우후후, 그동안 모험가님께는 드리질 못했으니, 채워드리려고 해요!: Hehehe. I haven't had the chance to feed you lately, so I'm making up for it!
strings.모자라시면 말씀하세요!: Let me know if it's not enough!
strings.모자라지는 않을 것 같아요!: I don't think that will be a problem!
strings.그렇게 말씀하시면 섭섭한데…. 그런데 무슨 일로 오셨어요? 스스로 원해서: That's a little disappointing... What brings you here, though? I doubt you came of your own accord to eat cakes and desserts.
strings.(젤릭에게 이오가 새로운 디저트를 원하고 있다는 이야기를 전한다.): (You tell Jelic that Io is looking for a new dessert.)
strings.오, 역시 훌륭하신 분이세요. 새로운 디저트를 원하시다니…. 마을 입구에: Oh, she has excellent taste. A new dessert... All those cake boxes I left at the village entrance like Santa Claus paid off!
The snowfield's special snow and ice kept them fresh.
strings.…대체 어디까지 디저트를 뿌리러 가는 거예요?: ...Just how far do you travel to hand out desserts?
strings.마계 같이 일반적으로 갈 수 없는 곳을 제외하면 거의 다 뿌렸을 걸요?: Apart from places people can't normally reach, like the Demon Realm, I think we've covered almost everywhere.
strings.최근에 마법학원 제레니스 학생들 취향에 맞는 빵을 만들었는데, 그게 좋을: I recently made a bread tailored to the tastes of the students at Xerenis Magic Academy. That should do nicely!
I'll give you the recipe, but on one condition.
strings.맛을 보셔야 하잖아요. 마법학원 제레니스 학교 매점 독점 공급이라 직접: You'll need to taste it first. It's supplied exclusively to the Xerenis Magic Academy shop, so you'll have to get some there yourself.
I see. I'll go get a few.
strings.게르다 사람들이 먹으려면 최소 오십 개 정도면 되겠죠? 학생들이 숨겨둔: To feed everyone in Gerda, you'll need at least fifty, right? The students should have plenty stashed away. Find fifty and take them with you! That's my condition!
Hehehe! Now, I'm busy, so I'd better get back to work.
strings.이거 음식배달부가 된 거 같은데…. 그나저나 무슨 빵이지?: I feel like a food delivery worker... What kind of bread is it, anyway?
strings.맛있는 냄새가 나서 와봤더니, %s 님께서 뭔가 잔뜩 들고 오셨군요. 안: I smelled something delicious and came to investigate. You've brought quite a lot, %s. Io has been looking forward to it...
...It's popular with students, so I don't know if you'll like it.
strings.이오 님 본인은 무엇이든지 잘 드신다고 하시지만, %s 님께서 가져오신: Io says she'll happily eat anything, but this you've brought, %s...
strings.(갈렛이 민트 초코 크림 브레드를 하나 꺼내 입에 문다.): (Galette takes a bite of a Mint Chocolate Cream Bread.)
strings.독특하고 부드러운 민트 크림과 강하고 달콤한 초코 크림이 한데 어울려 뒤: The distinctive, smooth mint cream mingling with rich, sweet chocolate cream... This flavor is unmistakably...
strings.확실하게 제 취향은 아닙니다만, 게르다 사람들에게는 신선한 자극이 될 것: It certainly isn't to my taste, but I think the people of Gerda will find it a refreshing change.
strings.기회가 된다면 마을 입구에 케이크를 상자에 담아 뿌리고 간 인물을 초대하: If I get the chance, I'd like to invite the person who left all those cake boxes at the village entrance.
strings.어떻게 이런 음식을 만들 수 있는 거지?: How does anyone come up with food like this?
I'm sure you'll have a chance someday. Oh, what's that...?
strings.아, 마들린이 가게 안에 걸어두라고 한 액자예요. 눈꽃인데 참 예쁘죠?: Ah, Madeleine asked me to hang that frame in the shop. It's a snow flower. Beautiful, isn't it?
That flower... I see. I'll have a look around elsewhere, then. See you later.
strings.%s 님, 나중에 식사하러 오세요. 후우, 손님도 없으니 나는 산책이나: Come back for a meal sometime, %s. Hmm, no customers. Perhaps I'll take a walk...
Of course, the moment I say that, a customer arrives.
strings.환영합니다! 저는 반짝거리는 눈 위의 꽃, 여관 설화(雪花)를 운영하는: Welcome! I'm Galette, proprietor of the Snowflower Inn, a blossom upon the sparkling snow. Is this your first visit to the village?
strings.(갈렛의 앞으로 어떤 여성이 다가온다. 수도사 복장 같지만, 검을 들고: (A woman approaches Galette. She appears dressed as a monk, yet carries a sword, creating a curious impression.)
strings.아, 아니에요. 제가 잘 생긴 남자에게 약해서…. 헙. 아니에요. 이오: Oh, n-no. I have a weakness for handsome men... Ah! Never mind. Io told me to ask you about a room...
Haha, I see. May I have your name for the guest register?
strings.저, 저! 레, 렌, 이라고 해요!: I-I'm! R-Ren! My name is Ren!
